workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: enable_lora on Jamba (ai21labs/Jamba-tiny-dev) causes a CUDA illegal memory access followed by an uncaught C++ exception (`terminate called ... c10::AcceleratorError`) during startup
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][LoRA] Give Mamba-1 LoRA layers every row of the batch. Target files: vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/mamba_mixer.py. . With LoRA enabled, `MambaMixer` (Mamba-1, used by `JambaForCausalLM` and `MambaForCausalLM`) gave `x_proj`, `dt_proj` and `out_proj` only part of the batch's rows. The LoRA kernels index rows through the whole batch's mapping, so they went out of bounds. This PR gives those layers a batch-sized input when LoRA is enabled. Root cause and GPU traces: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/618... (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64681)

workarounds.symptom: Enable mac clipboard via pngpaste (Support unseekable attachments)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Support pipe paths for CLI attachments. Target files: llm/cli.py, tests/test_attachments.py. Attachments passed through Bash process substitution, such as `llm "Describe this image" -a <(cat image.png)`, could not be detected because MIME probing expects a seekable file. With an explicit `--at` type, hashing and subsequent reads could instead consume the pipe and lose its content. (Ref: https://github.com/simonw/llm/pull/1857)

workarounds.symptom: Responses API silently truncates oversized input with truncation disabled (0.40.13 and 0.40.14, Bonsai 27B)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: openai: forward truncation option in responses requests. Target files: openai/responses.go, openai/responses_test.go, server/responses_compact.go. ﻿`FromResponsesRequest` previously omitted mapping the `Truncation` option to `api.ChatRequest.Truncate`. Because `Truncate` was nil on the resulting request, the chat handler defaulted `truncate` to `true`, causing oversized inputs to be silently shortened by the runner even when `truncation` was set to `"disabled"` (or left at the default `"disabled"`). (Ref: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/pull/19501)
